subject: Week 0: MAP alignment, evaluation gates, and close timeline
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@vectorhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Week 0: MAP alignment, evaluation gates, and close timeline

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Per our call, I wanted to capture a concise Week 0 plan so we have shared expectations for the MAP, evaluation flow, and the decision gates that will drive a Q3 close. Attached are a draft MAP and the evaluation criteria doc.

High-level proposal (please skim and tell me what to change):
- Cadence: weekly 30-min checkpoints (Wednesdays, 30 minutes) for the next 6 weeks; ad-hoc working sessions for blockers
- Success criteria (minimums to pass each gate):
  - Gate 1 (Proof point): integration + 1k anonymized records processed end-to-end, <300ms average per-request 95th percentile
  - Gate 2 (Quality): BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics for extraction tasks; client-provided evaluation set accuracy >= 88% on key intents
  - Gate 3 (Ops readiness): autoscaling smoke, KV cache warm-up < 10s, monitoring alerts wired to your oncall
- Decision timeline: Gate 1 review by July 2; Gate 2 review by July 16; final procurement signoff target July 30

Immediate asks for Week 0 (owners / due dates):
1) Confirm list of stakeholder attendees for weekly checkpoints (owner: Sara / due: 2025-06-20)
2) Share a sanitized sample of the dataset we should use for the POC (owner: VectorHealth Data Team / due: 2025-06-24)
3) Redwood to provide a minimal MAP spreadsheet with milestones and owners (owner: Sergio / due: 2025-06-19) — attached as MAP_v1.0.xlsx
4) Redwood to provide evaluation rubric + automated test harness outline (owner: Marissa / due: 2025-06-24) — attached as eval-criteria.pdf

Logistics: our suggested weekly slot is Wednesdays 10:00-10:30 PT, starting 2025-06-25. If that doesn't work, propose a time. We'll record checkpoints and keep the MAP updated in the attached spreadsheet.

I'll also create a HubSpot deal and post the relevant links (see included link to the draft deal).

Looking forward — if we can lock stakeholders and the dataset this week we can hit Gate 1 by the July 2 checkpoint.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet), eval-criteria.pdf (PDF)
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@vectorhealth.com>

Cc: VectorHealth Procurement <procurement@vectorhealth.com>, Ravi Desai <ravi.desai@vectorhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Week 0: MAP alignment, evaluation gates, and close timeline

Thanks Sergio — this looks good and aligned with our expectations.

Quick responses:
- Weekly cadence works; Wednesdays 10:00 PT is fine for the core group.
- I'll confirm the stakeholder list by Friday (we'll include Ravi from data platform, and our PM, Lila).
- We'll provide a sanitized data extract (anonymized) by 2025-06-24.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood include a short checklist for security/compliance steps we'll need for the POC (SOC2 evidence, retention settings, and access controls)?
- Can we see a short runbook for how you handle KV cache warm-up and cost estimates for 1k-record runs?

I'll loop Procurement on the cadence/decision dates so they can align budget timing.

Sara
Sara Patel
VP Product, VectorHealth
sara.patel@vectorhealth.com | +1 650-555-0198

Team —

Recap of what's already committed and the owners I assigned in the external note. Please treat this as the operational checklist for Week 0 so we present a single, tight plan to VectorHealth.

Meeting cadence: Wednesdays 10:00-10:30 PT (first meeting 2025-06-25)

Action items (internal view):
- Sergio: Update MAP_v1.0.xlsx with milestones and HubSpot links (due 2025-06-19) [DONE - v1 uploaded to Drive]
- Marissa: Draft evaluation harness + smoke test scripts; outline CI steps for automated scoring (due 2025-06-24) — file: eval-criteria.pdf (working draft)
- Ben: Prep demo environment and small-scale dataset ingestion script; coordinate with Infra for a reserved 1xA10 instance for the PoC (due 2025-06-24)
- Evelyn: Pull SOC2 evidence bundle and prepare a short compliance checklist (due 2025-06-23)

Notes on risk and mitigations:
- Risk: Dataset delivery delays — mitigation: ask for a synthetic extract we can seed in 48 hours.
- Risk: Unexpected latency on longer sequences — mitigation: schedule an ops smoke session during Week 0 (Ben + Infra).

Please reply-all with any changes to owners or dates. I'll paste the finalized MAP link into HubSpot and start the weekly meeting invite once Sara confirms the attendee list.

Sergio
